title: UAV Companion itinerary
description: A GeoJSON FeatureCollection of places for the UAV Companion map. Paste it into Points of Interest > Plan with an AI, or open it as a share link. Only name is required; day and order are optional; a place without coordinates needs properties.query so the app can look it up.

trip.description: Optional. When the whole itinerary is one trip: the app creates it (or uses yours if it already exists) and puts every place in it, except a residence.

country.description: Country name in English, or its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Optional; unknown values are dropped.

endDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, not before startDate. Optional, and only with startDate.

coordinates.description: [longitude, latitude] in decimal degrees (WGS84). Only when accurate for that exact place.

type.description: home = the drone's home point. residence = the traveller's own home; only if the itinerary asks for it. hotel is shown in the app as Accommodation (any place to stay). transport = a bus stop, ferry pier or car park, not a train station or airport. photo = a spot to fly or film at; attraction = a sight to visit.

date.description: Calendar date of the visit, YYYY-MM-DD with the year. Optional: only when the itinerary states the full date.

endDate.description: Last date of a multi-day stay, YYYY-MM-DD, later than date. Optional, and only with date.

day.description: Itinerary day, 1 is the first day. Only for an itinerary with no calendar dates: when dates are given, leave this out (the app works the day out from the date and the trip start). Optional.

order.description: Position within the day, 1 is the first stop. Optional.

sideQuest.description: Optional. true for an optional nearby extra (a Side Quest) rather than a place the traveller is planning to go. Never for a hotel, home or residence.

near.description: Optional, with sideQuest: the exact name of the main stop (another feature) it is close to.

query.description: Searchable text for a place without coordinates: venue, address, city, country, in English.

queryLocal.description: Optional. The same place in its own local language and script, tried if the English query finds nothing.
